claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive, reaction, and weapon-rule riders depend on the staff's current form, but the current predicate surface can only say that the item is being held.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current effect atoms cannot grant the Thrown property or author a weapon's normal and long ranges in one form only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic post-ranged-attack return rider, and there is no current atom or relation for a thrown weapon automatically returning to the wielder's hand.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
